specific_passages.passage_anchor: In November 1645. a Citizen of London
specific_passages.page_location: Top narrative and three numbered questions above Chap.XXX

rules.source_statement: A London citizen had gone into the West of England and no news had been received for many weeks. His brother asked whether he was alive or dead; if dead, whether soldiers had killed him; if alive, when news would come and where he was; and when he would return home. The source connects the soldier question to the kingdom then being full of soldiery. The printed figure is dated Friday7 November1645, at hora meridiana.
source_alternatives: Living versus dead is the first requested decision; being killed by soldiers is conditional on a judgment of death.
qualifications_and_limits: No modern calendar or timezone convention is stated by the chart.
Historical worked judgement or source testimony only; not an independently verified outcome or an automatic universal rule.
